title: Senior Staff Digital Methodology Engineer - Design for Testability (DFT)
description:
**Date posted** 10/28/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19504****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/28/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

### **You Are**

You have spent over a decade architecting test solutions for chips that power everything from autonomous vehicles to data centers, and you understand that DFT is not an afterthought, it is the difference between a design that ships on time and one that bleeds money in yield loss. You know the nuances of scan compression versus hierarchical DFT, not from a textbook, but from making the call on a 10-billion-gate SoC where the wrong decision costs months.

You are the person design teams call when ATPG coverage is stuck at 97% and manufacturing is demanding 99.5%. You have debugged IJTAG networks that span multiple chiplets, written the Tcl that automated what used to take three engineers a week, and sat in rooms with VPs explaining why their test access strategy needs to change before tapeout. You do not just know the IEEE standards, you have deployed them in production silicon and lived with the consequences.

At Synopsys, you will work on methodologies that define how the world's most complex chips get tested. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and what you build will matter.

  
  

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Define and drive DFT methodologies for next-generation ASIC and SoC designs across strategic customer programs, translating architecture decisions into deployable best practices
* Lead deployment of advanced test solutions including scan compression, hierarchical DFT, IEEE 1500 wrappers, IJTAG instrumentation networks, and embedded test IP across multi-billion-gate designs
* Architect scalable test access infrastructures using IEEE 1149.1, IEEE 1149.6, IEEE 1687, and IEEE 1500 standards for complex multi-die and chiplet-based systems
* Develop automation frameworks, signoff criteria, and reusable methodology packages using Tcl, Python, and Perl that accelerate adoption across business units
* Serve as technical leader and subject matter expert for Synopsys TestMAX DFT, TestMAX ATPG, diagnosis, and silicon lifecycle solutions in customer engagements and internal escalations
* Collaborate directly with R&D teams to influence TestMAX product roadmap based on real deployment challenges and customer requirements
* Provide technical leadership for strategic customer engagements, methodology reviews, and complex DFT architecture decisions that impact tapeout schedules and silicon success
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Enable successful deployment of industry-leading DFT methodologies across the world's most advanced semiconductor programs in AI, automotive, and hyperscale computing
* Drive measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and manufacturing yield through methodology standardization and best-practice development
* Influence next-generation TestMAX capabilities by translating customer deployment challenges into product requirements that shape future releases
* Accelerate adoption of standards-based test architectures across strategic accounts, reducing time-to-market and improving silicon reliability
* Improve engineering productivity across multiple programs through automation frameworks and reusable methodology packages that eliminate redundant work
* Establish Synopsys as the trusted technical advisor in DFT and manufacturing test, strengthening customer relationships and competitive positioning
* Contribute to breakthrough technologies powering autonomous vehicles, AI accelerators, and next-generation networking infrastructure
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
* 10+ years in semiconductor or EDA industry with at least 5 years focused on DFT architecture, ATPG, and manufacturing test methodologies
* Demonstrated expertise architecting and implementing DFT solutions for large-scale ASIC and SoC designs, including successful tapeouts
* Hands-on experience with Synopsys TestMAX DFT and TestMAX ATPG solutions in production design environments
* Deep technical knowledge of scan insertion, scan compression, hierarchical DFT, ATPG and diagnosis, stuck-at/transition/path-delay/bridge/cell-aware fault models, and coverage optimization techniques
* Expertise deploying IEEE 1149.1 (JTAG), IEEE 1149.6 (AC JTAG), IEEE 1687 (IJTAG), and IEEE 1500 standards in complex test access architectures
* Experience integrating DFT IP including Codec/embedded compression, OCC, LBIST, TAP controllers, JTAG and IJTAG infrastructure, TDR networks, and IEEE 1500 wrappers
* Strong understanding of RTL-to-GDSII flows and how DFT interacts with synthesis, physical design, timing closure, and signoff
* Proficiency with Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting for methodology automation and deployment
* Experience defining enterprise-wide DFT standards and signoff methodologies is a strong plus
* Background supporting advanced-node ASICs, multi-billion-gate SoCs, silicon bring-up, diagnosis, or yield improvement is highly valued
* Knowledge of functional safety standards and automotive test requirements is a plus
* Contributions to industry test standards, technical publications, patents, or conference presentations strengthen your candidacy
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room with a customer's design team, diagnose a coverage gap in their hierarchical DFT strategy, and sketch a solution on the whiteboard that they trust enough to implement before tapeout
* You mentor engineers not by telling them what to do, but by asking the questions that help them see the tradeoff they missed between test time and pattern count
* You are comfortable presenting a methodology roadmap to a VP in two slides and then diving three levels deep with an engineer debugging an IJTAG network the same afternoon
* You push back when a proposed DFT architecture does not align with manufacturing realities, and you do it in a way that builds trust rather than friction
* You treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not an afterthought, because you know the methodology only scales if the Tcl actually works
* You stay current with industry trends, standards evolution, and emerging test challenges because you know that what worked on 7nm will not necessarily work on 3nm
  

  

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the Digital Methodology Center of Excellence, a highly visible organization responsible for defining and advancing Synopsys' DFT methodologies, best practices, and customer deployment strategies. Working closely with R&D, product engineering, customer success, and strategic accounts, you will help shape the future of Design-for-Test and drive successful adoption of the industry's most advanced test solutions worldwide.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: IT Systems Administrator (Cloud, Identity, Endpoint & Security)
description:
**Transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses into fully-autonomous food production sites**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At eternal.ag, we're building the future of sustainable food production. Our mission is to convert the world's existing greenhouses into fully automated facilities that can produce fresh food year-round - addressing the critical need to double food production by 2050 while facing severe labor shortages, water scarcity, and climate challenges.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an IT Systems Administrator to own and improve day-to-day IT operations across cloud services, identity, endpoint devices, and cybersecurity controls. You will manage AWS infrastructure basics, Microsoft 365 services, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) identity and access, Windows PCs, and Ubuntu/Linux laptops. You will also implement and administer Mobile Device Management (MDM) and help establish and enforce practical cybersecurity policies and best practices across the company.  
  
This is a hands-on role requiring strong troubleshooting skills, structured documentation habits, and the ability to balance user support with system reliability and security.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**IT operations & user support**

* Provide Tier 1–2 support for employees across hardware, OS, identity/login, network access, and SaaS tools.
* Provision, onboard, and offboard users (accounts, groups, device enrollment, licenses, access rights).
* Maintain IT documentation (runbooks, onboarding/offboarding checklists, asset records, system diagrams).
* Manage IT vendors and service providers as needed (ISPs, equipment suppliers, security tools).

**Microsoft 365 administration**

* Administer Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, and core admin settings.
* Manage licensing and service configuration aligned to business needs and cost control.
* Implement and monitor baseline security controls (e.g., MFA, security defaults/conditional access, mailbox security, secure sharing).
* Support email deliverability, domain/DNS records (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and collaboration settings.

**Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) / Identity & Access Management**

* Administer Microsoft Entra ID tenant configuration, users/groups, role-based access controls, and identity lifecycle.
* Implement access policies such as MFA, Conditional Access, device compliance requirements, and least-privilege access.
* Manage SSO integrations for SaaS applications and troubleshoot authentication issues.
* Support secure onboarding/offboarding and periodic access reviews.

**Endpoint management: Windows + Ubuntu/Linux**

* Maintain Windows PCs (deployment, patching, troubleshooting, device encryption, local admin controls, endpoint security).
* Maintain Ubuntu/Linux laptops (user access, updates, disk encryption where applicable, security hardening, troubleshooting).
* Standardize device setup using repeatable processes (imaging, configuration scripts, endpoint policies).
* Maintain endpoint inventory (hardware specs, ownership, lifecycle, warranty, status).

**Mobile Device Management (MDM) & device compliance**

* Implement and administer an MDM solution to enforce device security, configuration, and compliance.
* Examples: Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Kandji, or equivalent (choose what fits your environment).
* Define and enforce device baselines (PIN/biometrics, encryption, auto-lock, OS update requirements, remote wipe).
* Manage BYOD vs corporate-owned policies, and align with privacy/responsible monitoring expectations.
* Ensure smooth enrollment and support for iOS/Android and laptops where supported.

**AWS administration (cloud operations & governance)**

* Administer AWS accounts and foundational services used by the company, such as:
* IAM (users/roles/policies), security groups, VPC basics, EC2, S3, RDS (as applicable), CloudWatch/logging.
* Improve AWS security posture (least-privilege IAM, MFA for privileged access, key/secret hygiene).
* Support backups, monitoring/alerting, and incident response procedures for cloud workloads.
* Assist with cost visibility and optimization (tagging, budgets, alerts, rightsizing recommendations).

**Cybersecurity policies & best practices**

* Help define, implement, and maintain company cybersecurity policies and standards, such as:
* Acceptable use, password/MFA, endpoint security, patching, backups, access control, vendor access, secure sharing.
* Implement practical security controls aligned with the company’s risk level: Endpoint protection, encryption, vulnerability management, audit logging, least privilege, secure onboarding/offboarding.
* Run security awareness basics (phishing awareness, secure handling of data, reporting procedures).
* Support security incident response: triage, containment, remediation, post-incident improvements.
* Coordinate with external security vendors (pentest, audits, SOC/SIEM support) if applicable.

**Who You Are**
---------------

#### **Core requirements**

* 3+ years in IT administration / systems administration / IT operations.
* Strong experience administering Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including MFA and SSO.
* Hands-on experience managing Windows endpoints (deployment, patching, troubleshooting, security controls).
* Hands-on experience supporting Ubuntu/Linux laptops (updates, access, security hardening basics).
* Experience implementing or administering an MDM platform and device compliance policies.
* Familiarity with AWS administration fundamentals (IAM, networking basics, monitoring, security concepts).
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals: least privilege, secure configuration, patch management, encryption, phishing, backups, incident response basics.
* Strong troubleshooting ability, ability to communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues, and good documentation habits.

#### **Bonus points if you have**

* Experience with Microsoft security tooling (e.g., Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001 concepts, SOC 2 readiness, GDPR awareness) as applicable.
* Experience with automation/scripting: PowerShell (Windows/M365), Bash (Linux), Python (optional), and/or Ansible for configuration management.
* Basic networking skills: DHCP/DNS/VPN/Wi‑Fi management, firewall concepts, zero-trust principles.
* Experience with ticketing systems (Jira Service Management, Zendesk, Freshservice, etc.).
* Experience building policies and controls in a startup/SMB environment with pragmatic constraints.

#### **Soft skills & working style**

* You prioritize security and reliability without blocking productivity.
* You can translate technical risk into business impact and propose practical mitigations.
* You’re comfortable owning problems end-to-end and escalating appropriately.
* You can create simple documentation others can follow.
* You handle confidential information responsibly.

#### **Tools & Systems**

* Microsoft 365 Admin Center, Exchange Admin, Entra ID, Intune (or Jamf/Kandji/other MDM)
* AWS Console + IAM + CloudWatch (and IaC tools if applicable)
* Windows 10/11, Ubuntu/Linux
* Endpoint security tooling (Defender/CrowdStrike/SentinelOne, etc.)
* Password manager and/or SSO provider integrations
* Ticketing + asset management system

**Apply Now**
-------------

Ready to help transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses into fully automated food production sites? If you’re excited to build the IT and security foundation that lets a robotics team ship safely and move fast, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

*eternal.ag* *is building fully automated food production sites that can sustainably produce fresh food year-round. Backed by world-class investors and partnering with leading agricultural companies, we're turning the vision of fully-autonomous greenhouses into reality.*

description:
**Date posted** 10/25/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19275****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/25/2026**

### **Job Title:** * SoC Verification - Senior Manager

### **We Are**

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent over a decade in SoC verification, and somewhere along the way you realized that the hardest part of the job is not just catching bugs, it is building a team that catches them before they become expensive problems. You know what good verification looks like because you have written testbenches, debugged waveforms at 2 a.m., and closed coverage gaps on complex subsystems yourself. Now you lead teams through that same work, and you are good at it.

You understand customer engagements are not internal projects. Scope creeps, requirements shift, and timelines compress. You have learned to read between the lines when a customer says "we need verification support" and figure out what they actually need, then translate that into a plan your team can execute without drama.

Managing seven engineers across multiple projects means you spend your day context-switching between technical reviews, customer calls, and mentoring conversations. You do not micromanage, but you also do not disappear. You know when to step in and when to let someone work through a problem. At Synopsys, you will lead verification work that directly enables customers building chips for AI, automotive, aerospace, and high-performance computing. The work is real, the customers are demanding, and your team will depend on you to keep it all moving.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead and manage a team of 7-8 SoC and subsystem verification engineers working on customer engagements across automotive, aerospace, defense, and high-performance computing domains
* Work directly with Synopsys customers to scope verification activities, define deliverables, and translate their technical challenges into actionable verification plans
* Assess project complexity and resource needs, then propose staffing and timeline plans that actually hold up under execution pressure
* Mentor engineers daily on verification methodology, debug strategies, coverage closure, and customer communication, growing their technical depth for future assignments
* Review testbench code, verification plans, coverage reports, and waveform analysis to provide feedback that improves quality before deliverables go to the customer
* Report project status to senior management, flag risks early, and work through execution issues with peers and stakeholders across SSG, sales, and business unit application engineering teams
* Drive adoption of Synopsys verification tools including VCS, Verdi, and Synopsys VIP within customer projects, and collaborate with internal teams to refine methodology and improve efficiency

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Your team will deliver verification solutions that enable customers to tape out complex SoCs on schedule, directly affecting product launches in AI, automotive, and aerospace markets
* The engineers you mentor will grow into technical leads and customer-facing verification experts, strengthening Synopsys capability to take on larger, more complex engagements
* Your project scoping and resource planning will determine whether customer engagements stay on track or slip, affecting both customer satisfaction and SSG revenue
* The verification methodology improvements you drive will be reused across future projects, compounding efficiency gains across the entire Systems Solutions Group
* Your ability to translate customer needs into clear verification scope will shape how Synopsys tools and IP get deployed in real-world SoC projects
* The quality standards you enforce will define what customers expect from Synopsys verification services, setting the bar for future engagements
* Your collaboration with sales and AE teams will help position SSG for new customer opportunities and expand the types of verification work Synopsys can take on

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Electronics Engineering or related field with 12+ years of hands-on experience in SoC verification
* Deep technical expertise across pre-silicon verification including UVM testbench development, coverage analysis, verification planning, and complex debug using waveform tools
* Strong working knowledge of industry-standard protocols such as PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, and familiarity with processor, interconnect, or debug architectures
* Proven hands-on experience with VCS, Verdi or similar waveform analyzers, and integration of third-party VIP including Synopsys VIP
* Demonstrated ability to lead verification teams through complex SoC, subsystem, or IP verification projects from planning through delivery
* Experience managing verification scope, timelines, and resources for customer-facing projects or service engagements is a strong plus
* Solid understanding of ASIC design flows, RTL design concepts, and how verification fits into the broader chip development lifecycle

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a customer meeting, listen to a vague request for "verification support," and walk out with a concrete scope, timeline, and resource plan that your team can actually execute
* You review a coverage report or testbench and immediately spot what is missing, not just technically but strategically, and you explain it in a way that helps the engineer see it too
* You manage multiple projects without losing track of details, and your team knows you will catch issues before they escalate to the customer or senior management
* You push back when a customer asks for something unrealistic or when internal stakeholders propose a plan that will not work, and you do it in a way that keeps the relationship intact
* You communicate clearly with engineers, customers, and executives, adjusting your level of detail depending on who is in the room without oversimplifying or overcomplicating
* You treat mentoring as part of the job, not an extra task, and engineers on your team get better at verification because you invest time in their growth

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will join the System Solutions Group (SSG), a team that delivers end-to-end SoC design and verification services to Synopsys customers. SSG works on everything from subsystem blocks to full turnkey SoCs, serving customers that range from startups to industry leaders across high-performance computing, automotive, aerospace, and defense. Your verification team will collaborate closely with architects, RTL designers, and post-silicon teams, and you will work alongside peers in other SSG functions, sales, and Synopsys business unit application engineering teams to deliver customer engagements and refine internal methodology.

### **Rewards and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

We are hiring a target-driven Education Sales Executive / Business Development Counsellor to drive student admissions and revenue growth for our professional training academy.

The candidate will be responsible for managing sales enquiries, conducting course consultations, nurturing prospective students, closing admissions, and achieving monthly enrollment targets.

Our academy provides career-oriented courses in Digital Marketing, Graphic Designing, Video Editing, Web Development, App Development, E-commerce, Freelancing, Content Creation, and other professional skill development areas.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in educational sales or training institute admissions, excellent persuasion skills, and a proven ability to convert leads into paying students.

**This is a sales-focused role, not just a general counselling position.** The primary objective is to generate revenue through successful student enrollment and effective lead conversion.

Key Responsibilities

* Drive student admissions and business development for the academy's training programs.
* Handle inbound course enquiries and conduct outbound calls to prospective students.
* Convert marketing-generated leads into paid course enrollments through structured sales follow-ups.
* Explain course benefits, pricing, curriculum, career opportunities, and enrollment procedures.
* Identify prospective students' requirements and recommend suitable training programs.
* Follow up consistently with warm leads, interested prospects, and undecided applicants.
* Handle sales objections related to course fees, course value, career outcomes, competition, and payment concerns.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and track lead status, follow-up schedules, and conversion rates.
* Achieve daily calling, follow-up, monthly enrollment, and revenue targets.
* Identify opportunities to upsell advanced courses or recommend additional relevant programs where appropriate.
* Maintain accurate sales records using CRM software, Google Sheets, or other lead management tools.
* Coordinate with the marketing team to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and campaign performance.
* Share regular sales reports, lead feedback, and enrollment forecasts with management.
* Maintain professional communication and ensure a positive admission experience for every prospective student.

***Courses and Programs***

The candidate will be responsible for promoting and selling courses such as:

* Digital Marketing and Advanced Digital Marketing
* Graphic Designing and Creative Design
* Video Editing and Content Production
* Web Development and Website Designing
* App Development
* E-commerce and Online Business
* Freelancing and Client Acquisition
* Content Creator and Personal Branding Programs
* AI Tools and Emerging Digital Skills

***Eligibility Criteria***

* Minimum **3+ years of relevant experience** in education sales, course sales, business development, admissions, or sales at an EdTech company or training institute.
* Demonstrated experience in lead conversion, sales follow-ups, and achieving enrollment or revenue targets.
* Strong communication, negotiation, persuasion, and objection-handling abilities.
* Ability to confidently pitch courses and communicate their value to prospective students.
* Experience managing leads from digital advertising, websites, social media, telecalling, or other enquiry channels.
* Ability to work with sales targets, performance metrics, and structured follow-up processes.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets, MS Excel, WhatsApp Business, and CRM or lead management tools.
* Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working remotely with minimal supervision.
* Ability to manage multiple prospects and maintain an organized sales pipeline.

***Preferred Experience***

Preference will be given to candidates who have worked in:

* Digital marketing institutes or computer training centres.
* EdTech companies and online learning platforms.
* Professional certification and vocational training institutes.
* Career-oriented coaching centres or skill development academies.
* Education consultancy businesses with direct student enrollment targets.

Candidates with a consistent record of achieving sales targets and converting paid admissions will be preferred.

***Performance Expectations***

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Number of qualified leads contacted and followed up.
* Lead-to-admission conversion rate.
* Monthly student enrollment numbers.
* Revenue generated through course sales.
* Follow-up discipline and sales pipeline management.
* Overall contribution to the academy's business growth.

***Work Arrangement***

The position will initially be remote. As the academy expands, the role may transition to an onsite position based on business requirements. Applicants should be comfortable with this potential change.

***Salary and Career Growth***

* Competitive fixed salary based on relevant experience and demonstrated sales performance.
* Additional incentives linked to successful admissions and business development results.
* Opportunity to progress into Senior Education Sales Executive, Business Development Manager, Admissions Team Lead, or Sales Manager roles.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of a professional education and skill development business.

***How to Apply***

Candidates with at least 3 years of relevant experience in education sales, course admissions, EdTech sales, or business development are invited to apply.

Please submit your updated resume with details of your previous roles, sales responsibilities, and achievements in student enrollment or revenue generation.

**Note:** This is a target-oriented position. Candidates must be comfortable with follow-up calls, sales conversations, admission closures, and monthly performance goals. Freshers without relevant experience will not be considered.

title: Senior Principal - P&C Platform Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Build, automate and run the platform that 50,000+ employees across [X] countries use to communicate and collaborate — Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive, Exchange Online, the Microsoft 365 apps, Power Platform and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

This is the hands-on build role. The Platform Engineer takes architecture direction and a prioritised backlog and turns them into working, tested, automated, documented configuration in production. The expectation is engineering rather than administration: configuration expressed as code and deployed through pipelines, not clicked through a portal and remembered by whoever was on shift.

The role also runs what it builds. Platform Engineers own the operational health of their workloads — diagnosing the awkward, intermittent, only-happens-in-Tokyo problems that never reproduce in a lab, and eliminating the root cause rather than closing the ticket.

**Key Responsibilities**

  
* Design, build, test and deploy configuration across the Microsoft 365 estate: Teams policies, SharePoint and OneDrive settings, Exchange Online transport and mail flow, Purview policies, Entra ID groups and Conditional Access as it applies to collaboration workloads.
* Implement to the reference architecture and standards set by the Principal Architect; raise a design challenge when reality does not match the design rather than quietly deviating.
* Deliver backlog items from sprint to production with the tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback path included — "done" means running and observable, not merely configured.
* Build and maintain integrations using Microsoft Graph and platform APIs; write the connective tissue between M365, ServiceNow, HR systems and the wider application estate.
* Automate everything that would otherwise be done twice. Provisioning, lifecycle, reporting, remediation, joiner/mover/leaver flows, licence assignment and reclamation.
* Express tenant configuration as code in version control; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for policy and solution deployment with automated validation and staged ring-based rollout.
* Replace manual runbook steps with self-healing and self-service; treat a recurring manual task as a defect with a backlog item attached.
* Own operational health of assigned workloads: monitoring, alerting, capacity, service health response and performance.
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents and problems — third-line escalation for collaboration platform issues — and drive permanent root-cause elimination.
* Participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents affecting the collaboration platform.
* Manage the continuous change stream from Microsoft: assess message centre and roadmap items, test in a lab tenant, and implement, defer or disable with the reasoning recorded.
* Maintain patch, currency and configuration compliance; remediate vulnerabilities and drift.
* Implement and maintain security and information governance controls in the collaboration estate: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, external sharing controls, app consent and Conditional Access.
* Produce the evidence that audits require — configuration baselines, change records, access reviews — generated automatically wherever possible.
* Build to regulated-environment requirements where applicable, including GxP-validated systems and the qualification and change control they demand.
* Work daily with the Product Owner on refinement and estimation, and with the Architect on design; give honest estimates and flag risk early.
* Produce operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles good enough that the service desk can use them and the next engineer can pick the work up.
* Support and coach the service desk and second-line teams; reduce escalation volume by transferring capability, not by absorbing it.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and code review within the squad.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Strong practical experience is an acceptable substitute for formal qualification.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Information Protection and Compliance Administrator, Power Platform Solution Architect, Azure Administrator, ITIL v4 Foundation).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on Microsoft 365 platform engineering across the core collaboration workloads — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online / OneDrive and Microsoft Teams — at 50,000-user scale.
* Configuration-as-code for tenant settings — Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated validation and staged ring-based rollout — plus advanced PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP, retention — and the practical behaviour of external sharing, Conditional Access and app consent controls once real users meet them.
* Complex collaboration-platform troubleshooting across client, identity, network and service layers, with root-cause elimination rather than ticket closure.

**Experience Required**

* 15Years overall and 10+ years in IT engineering or platform operations, including 5+ years working hands-on with Microsoft 365 in a production enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting or engineering a tenant of 5,000+ users; comfortable with the difference between a small tenant and a large one.
* Demonstrable hands-on capability across at least two of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online/OneDrive, or Microsoft Teams — at a level that includes troubleshooting, not only configuration.
* Working PowerShell proficiency with real examples of automation delivered into production, plus practical experience calling the Microsoft Graph API.
* Familiarity with Git and pull-request-based working; willingness to work configuration-as-code if not already doing so.
* Experience operating in an ITIL-aligned change and incident process, including production change ownership.
* Experience delivering within a Scrum or Kanban squad, including refinement, estimation and sprint commitment.
* Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents.
* Fluent English, written and spoken; able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague.

**Desirable:**

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP/CSV/CSA and validated-system change control.
* Migration delivery at scale — on-premises Exchange or SharePoint to cloud, file share to OneDrive/SharePoint, tenant-to-tenant, or third-party platform (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Box) consolidation.
* Teams Phone / voice — Direct Routing, Operator Connect, PSTN migration.
* Teams Rooms and collaboration hardware — deployment, configuration and remote management at estate scale.
* Viva suite implementation — Connections, Engage, Learning, Insights.
* Power Platform development — Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Dataverse, Copilot Studio agents.
* A second language beyond PowerShell — Python, C# or Go — and experience building small services or Azure Functions.
* Infrastructure-as-code tooling — Bicep, ARM or Terraform for the Azure resources supporting the platform.
* Endpoint management adjacency — Intune, device compliance and the endpoint's role in Conditional Access.
* Security engineering exposure — Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, threat hunting in M365 audit data.
* Accessibility testing and remediation in collaboration tooling.

**Skills/Background**

  

* Deep hands-on configuration and troubleshooting across the core M365 workloads — Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, hybrid, anti-spam), SharePoint Online and OneDrive (site and permission models, sharing controls, migration), and Microsoft Teams (policies, lifecycle, meetings, channels).
* Entra ID as it applies to collaboration — groups and dynamic membership, Conditional Access, app registrations and consent, service principals and app-only authentication.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention and disposition — and the practical behaviour of each once real users meet it.
* Microsoft 365 apps deployment and configuration — servicing channels, policy management via the Cloud Policy service, add-in management.
* Power Platform administration — environments, DLP connector policies, solution deployment and ALM.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot implementation mechanics — licence assignment, permission and oversharing remediation, and grounding behaviour.
* Advanced PowerShell — modules, error handling, parameterisation, idempotency; scripts written to be maintained by someone else, not just to run once.
* Microsoft Graph API fluency — REST, delta queries, permission scopes, app-only auth, throttling and retry handling.
* Monitoring and diagnostics — Log Analytics and KQL, M365 usage and audit telemetry, Power BI reporting; instrumenting your own work so problems surface before users report them.
* Complex troubleshooting — methodical isolation of intermittent, multi-layer problems spanning client, identity, network and service.
* ITIL-aligned practice — incident, problem and change management executed properly at enterprise scale, including credible change records and rollback plans.
* Production discipline — testing in a lab tenant first, ring-based release, blast-radius awareness, and the habit of asking "what does this do to 50,000 people" before pressing apply.
* Clear technical writing — runbooks, knowledge articles and design notes others can actually follow.
* Ownership — sees an item through to working in production and stays with it when it misbehaves afterwards.
* Curiosity and self-direction — reads release notes, tests in a lab, and brings improvement ideas to refinement unprompted.
* Collaboration — works well with product, architecture, security and the service desk; explains technical constraint without condescension.
* User empathy — remembers that a policy setting is somebody's Monday morning.

**Skills**

Access Control (AC), Agile Methodology, Cisco Routing, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Data Migration Testing, Microsoft Office 365, Operator Interfaces, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

You have spent over a decade designing analog circuits that have to move data at speeds most engineers never touch, and you know that the difference between a SERDES that works in simulation and one that works in silicon is a hundred small decisions about layout, process variation, and timing handoff. You are the kind of engineer who reads a SerDes standard and immediately starts sketching architectures that push beyond what the spec requires because you see where the bottleneck will be two years from now.

You do not wait for someone to tell you the PLL is the problem. You run the jitter budget, trace it back to the oscillator, and propose three solutions before the next design review. Taped-out circuits in FinFET nodes where a few femtofarads of parasitic capacitance can kill your bandwidth have taught you to work with layout engineers who understand that your redline is not optional.

Presenting simulation data to a customer review panel and explaining why your adaptive equalizer architecture will handle their worst-case channel without adding another milliwatt is something you do comfortably. Mentoring matters to you, not because it looks good on a review, but because you remember the senior engineer who taught you how to read an eye diagram and you want to be that person for someone else.

At Synopsys, you will work on Multi-Gbps SERDES IP that goes into chips that power data centers, automotive networks, and AI accelerators. The problems are hard, the process nodes are cutting-edge, and what you design will ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Review high-speed SerDes standards (PCIe, Ethernet, USB, CXL) and translate them into transceiver architectures and detailed sub-block specifications for Multi-Gbps NRZ and PAM4 designs

* Analyze customer silicon data and field performance to identify improvement opportunities and drive post-silicon design updates for next-generation IP releases

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Define the architectural direction for Synopsys SERDES IP, influencing product roadmaps and enabling next-generation connectivity standards across automotive, data center, and AI markets
* Deliver power, performance, and area improvements that directly affect the competitiveness of Synopsys IP in advanced process nodes and high-speed communication applications
* Solve post-silicon challenges that unblock customer tape-outs and ensure successful deployment of Synopsys IP in high-volume production chips
* Mentor analog designers across the team, raising the technical bar for circuit design, simulation methodology, and design-for-reliability practices
* Strengthen Synopsys leadership in Multi-Gbps SERDES by contributing to industry standards bodies, customer engagements, and technical publications
* Enable faster time-to-market for customers by streamlining design and verification flows and reducing silicon respins through robust pre-silicon validation
* Shape the future of high-speed analog design at Synopsys by driving innovation in adaptive equalization, low-power PLLs, and signal integrity for next-generation process technologies

### **What You'll Need**

* MTech/MS with 8+ years or BTech/BS with 10+ years of hands-on analog IC design experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Proven track record of CMOS tape-outs in FinFET technologies with demonstrable experience in Multi-Gbps high-speed designs using NRZ and PAM4 modulation

Experience with ESD protection, custom digital design, and design-for-reliability considerations (electromigration, IR drop, aging, self-heating) is a plus. title: IT System Administrator
description:
**About Us :-**

We are a healthcare technology company supporting virtual care programmes across the United States. Reliable IT  
  
operations, secure access, and careful handling of company and healthcare information are essential to our day-to-day  
  
work.

**Role Summary**

We are looking for 5-8 years experienced, hands-on IT Systems Administrator to support employees and day-to-day IT  
  
operations from India, primarily during U.S.-aligned working hours. The role combines Microsoft 365 administration, user  
  
support, onboarding and offboarding, with a critical focus on Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and Azure virtual  
  
machine operations. The successful candidate should be able to provision VMs, troubleshoot AVD and remote access  
  
issues, and resolve user access and connectivity problems. AWS knowledge is useful at a foundational or support level;  
  
strong practical Azure and AVD skills are the priority.

Critical Skill Area: Microsoft Azure & Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD)

  

Hands-on Azure and AVD experience is the most important technical requirement. The candidate should be able to carry  
  
out routine administration and first-/second-level troubleshooting, follow change and security procedures, document  
  
actions, and escalate complex infrastructure issues with useful diagnostic details.

* Provision new Azure virtual machines using approved images and sizing; select the correct subscription, resource

  
group, region, VM size, disk configuration, and network settings according to documented requirements.  
  

* Start, stop, restart, and check the health/status of Azure VMs; identify common causes of a VM being unavailable.

  

* Support AVD user access: validate user/group assignment, application group or desktop assignment, host pool

  
association, and relevant access prerequisites.

* Troubleshoot AVD sign-in and connection problems, including users unable to see desktops/apps, failed connections,

  
session launch errors, profile-loading issues, and sessions that are disconnected or unresponsive.  
  

* Perform initial checks on session hosts: availability, registration/health status, capacity, resource utilisation, and

  
whether the host is accepting connections; escalate host-pool or service-level issues when needed.  
  

* Investigate remote access issues involving user permissions, Entra ID sign-in, MFA, network reachability, DNS, VPN

  
where applicable, and RDP/AVD client configuration.  
  

* Review Azure VM and AVD diagnostic information, activity logs, monitoring signals, and relevant error messages to

  
gather evidence before escalating.  
  

* Support AVD/RDP onboarding and offboarding, including granting and removing approved access and validating that

  
changes have taken effect.

* Assist with Windows VM maintenance such as routine updates, reboot coordination, disk-space checks, basic

  
performance troubleshooting, and post-maintenance validation, following change approvals.  
  

* Understand resource groups, virtual networks/subnets, network security groups (NSGs), managed disks,

  
snapshots/images, Azure Monitor, and Azure Backup; make changes only within approved permissions and  
  
procedures.  
  

* Follow secure-access practices: never expose RDP broadly to the internet, do not bypass access controls, and

  
escalate suspected security incidents or unauthorised access immediately.  
  

* Maintain clear ticket notes covering the issue, checks performed, findings, actions taken, outcome, and any escalation

  
or follow-up required.

**Microsoft 365 & User Administration**

* Handle routine Microsoft 365 administration for user accounts, licences, Outlook/Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive,

  
and SharePoint access.  
  

* Troubleshoot common sign-in, password/MFA, mailbox, Teams, and permissions issues; recognise when an issue

  
requires escalation.  
  

* Create/configure user accounts and access during onboarding; disable accounts, remove licences, and revoke access

  
during offboarding, following approved checklists.  
  

* Manage basic group membership, distribution list membership, shared mailbox access, and other approved access

  
requests.  
  

* Verify approvals before granting access or changing user accounts, licences, groups, or shared resources.

**User Support, Tickets & IT Operations**

* Own and progress assigned support tickets for U.S.-based users, prioritising by business impact and urgency.

  

* Acknowledge requests, communicate progress clearly, set realistic expectations, and update tickets before closure.

  

* Resolve common Windows, laptop, peripheral, connectivity, application, and account-access issues; escalate issues

  
outside the role's permissions or expertise.  
  

* Maintain accurate laptop and accessory inventory and asset assignment/acknowledgement records.

  

* Follow documented onboarding/offboarding checklists and record completion.

  

* Document repeat incidents and troubleshooting steps so the team can resolve similar issues consistently.

**AWS — Foundational / Secondary Support**

AWS is a secondary skill area rather than the primary ownership requirement. The candidate should have basic familiarity  
  
with the AWS console and be able to assist with straightforward support checks under guidance.  
  

* Understand the purpose of IAM users/roles and permissions, EC2 instances, security groups, and S3 buckets.

  

* Perform basic status and access checks, gather troubleshooting information, and escalate AWS issues that require

  
deeper administration.  
  

* Follow least-privilege and approval requirements; do not make unapproved changes to production resources or

  
permissions.

**Security, Documentation & Escalation**

* Follow access approval processes, least-privilege principles, MFA requirements, and company security procedures.

  

* Handle company and healthcare-related information carefully; do not include sensitive information in unauthorised

  
tools or ticket notes.  
  

* Escalate critical incidents, suspected security issues, repeated failures, or changes with production impact promptly.

  

* Maintain useful documentation for VM provisioning, AVD access, common connection issues, onboarding/offboarding,

  
and recurring incidents.

**Working Hours & Support Coverage**

This is an India-based role. The employee will primarily work U.S.-aligned hours to support the company's users and IT  
  
operations. Flexibility is required to provide support during India business hours when a critical incident or urgent business requirement makes it necessary. India-hours support is for critical needs and is not the routine working schedule.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Practical hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD); this is the critical technical

  
requirement.  
  

* Ability to provision Azure VMs and troubleshoot common VM availability, AVD sign-in, desktop/application access,

  
session, and connectivity issues.  
  

* Working understanding of Azure subscriptions, resource groups, VM sizing/disks, virtual networks, NSGs, and basic

  
Azure monitoring/logs.  
  

* Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365 user administration and common Outlook, Teams, account, licence, and

  
access issues.  
  

* Experience handling user support tickets and following structured onboarding/offboarding processes.

  

* Clear written and spoken communication, reliable ticket updates, good documentation, and willingness to escalate

  
appropriately.  
  

* Based in India and available to work primarily U.S.-aligned hours, with flexibility to support critical incidents during

  
India business hours.

**Nice to Have**

* Basic AWS exposure, especially IAM, EC2, security groups, and S3.

  

* Experience with Windows Server, RDP, Entra ID, MFA, VPN, DNS, and networking fundamentals.

  

* Familiarity with PowerShell or basic scripting for troubleshooting and repetitive tasks.

  

* Experience with Freshdesk or another ticketing/ITSM platform.

  

* Exposure to endpoint security, BitLocker, device inventory, or healthcare/regulatory environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Routine Azure VM and AVD requests are handled accurately, securely, and with appropriate documentation.

  

* AVD access and connection issues are investigated systematically, resolved where within scope, and escalated with

  
useful evidence when needed.  
  

* user tickets handled during U.S.-aligned working hours receive timely updates and are progressed according to urgency and agreed service expectations.

  

* Onboarding and offboarding tasks are completed using approved checklists, with access changes recorded.

  

* Critical incidents are escalated promptly, and the employee can provide critical India-hours support when required.

**Suggested Experience Level**
  
  
Experience level: Open to candidates with relevant hands-on IT administration and systems support experience.  
  
Demonstrable practical Azure and AVD capability is essential; the role title and seniority can be aligned to the candidate's depth of experience.

description:
**Date posted** 10/14/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19281****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/14/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

  
  

### **You Are**

You have spent years in the trenches of mixed-signal verification, and you know that the hardest problems live at the boundary where digital meets analog. You are the engineer who can read a waveform, spot the timing violation that three others missed, and trace it back to a testbench assumption made two months ago. You do not just run regressions, you architect verification strategies that catch the subtle, the corner case, the thing that only shows up at 56 Gbps under specific PVT conditions.

  
  

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead verification of high-speed SerDes IP using UVM and SystemVerilog testbenches in mixed-signal co-simulation environments
* Define, track, and execute verification test plans for PCIE, Ethernet, USB3.1, and other high-speed protocols from architecture through tapeout
* Debug simulation failures across digital and analog domains, working directly with waveform viewers, mixed-signal simulators, and protocol analyzers
* Build and extend UVM testbenches with constrained random sequences, coverage models, and checkers that target real-world corner cases
* Collaborate daily with digital, analog, and mixed-signal design teams to align verification strategy with design intent and silicon bring-up realities
* Manage customer escalations by reproducing issues, root-causing failures, and driving resolution with engineering and field teams
* Drive pre-sales and post-sales technical discussions with customers, translating verification results into confidence and clarity
  

  

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure that SerDes IP shipping to customers meets performance, functionality, and reliability targets before it ever reaches silicon
* Reduce post-silicon debug cycles by catching mixed-signal integration issues early through rigorous co-simulation and coverage-driven verification
* Set the technical direction for verification methodology across current and next-generation SerDes products
* Accelerate customer adoption and satisfaction by resolving escalations quickly and providing clear, actionable technical guidance
* Mentor and elevate the verification team by establishing best practices, code reviews, and a culture of ownership and quality
* Contribute directly to Synopsys IP competitiveness by delivering verification environments that scale across protocol variants and process nodes
* Influence product roadmaps by surfacing verification insights that shape architecture and design decisions upstream
  

  

### **What You'll Need**

* MTech or BTech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent with 7+ years of hands-on verification experience in ASIC or mixed-signal environments
* Deep expertise in UVM, SystemVerilog, and verification methodologies including constrained random testing, functional coverage, and assertions
* Proven experience with digital/analog co-simulation tools and methodologies, including AMS simulators and mixed-signal verification flows
* Working knowledge of high-speed interface protocols such as PCIE, Ethernet, or USB3.1, including protocol-level verification and compliance
* Strong understanding of the full ASIC development flow from architecture specification through RTL design, verification, and hardware bring-up
* Experience writing complex system-level testbenches in UVM, including sequence libraries, scoreboards, and protocol monitors
* Hands-on experience debugging waveform-level failures in both digital logic and analog circuit behavior
  

  

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a room with analog designers discussing CDR loop dynamics and digital engineers debating clock domain crossings, and contribute meaningfully to both conversations
* You have managed customer escalations before and know how to balance urgency with thoroughness, reproducing the issue, isolating root cause, and communicating status without overselling or underselling
* You lead by setting the example, whether that is writing cleaner testbench code, asking the hard question in a design review, or staying late to close a critical bug before tapeout
* You make decisions with incomplete information, prioritize what matters, and course-correct when new data arrives without losing momentum
* You can explain a complex verification failure to a field applications engineer in two sentences and to a design lead in a ten-minute whiteboard session, adjusting depth and framing to the audience
* You build relationships across functions because you know that the best verification strategies come from understanding what design, applications, and customers actually need
  

  

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**

You will be part of a highly skilled team of digital, analog, and mixed-signal engineers responsible for delivering high-end mixed-signal designs from specification to implementation. This team thrives on collaboration, excellence, and pushing the boundaries of technology to deliver top-notch SerDes products to customers worldwide.

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

description:
**Date posted** 10/11/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19196****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/11/2026**

**Vulnerability Management Analyst - Semiconductor IP**

**We Are:**

At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.

**You Are:**

You are someone who builds trust with product and engineering teams when the topic is risk. You listen first, explain complex findings in clear language, and own your conclusions. You help people understand what a vulnerability means for their work and what they should do next.

You are practical when information is incomplete. You stay focused on timely action, challenge unclear choices in a respectful way, and keep looking for better ways to reduce risk. You care about teamwork, follow-through, and leaving guidance that others can use.

This is a full-time role.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Analyze vulnerabilities affecting semiconductor IP products, firmware, and related interfaces, and determine residual risk with clear assumptions.
* Prioritize findings so product teams can act in a timely way: severity, exploitability, affected assets, and recommended mitigations.
* Work with design, verification, firmware, and product teams to explain vulnerabilities, walk through impact, and agree how the team will mitigate.
* Advise those teams on practical mitigations, compensating controls, and verification or test evidence that shows the risk is reduced.
* Work in semiconductor IP development and associated test flows, using the tools those teams use to design, verify, and test IP, so analysis matches how the product is actually built.
* Build and maintain your own analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting tools, including in Python, when existing tools are not enough. Scripts and tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Track open risk through the cybersecurity lifecycle, from intake through analysis, treatment, verification, and internal release decisions, and keep status current.
* Facilitate working sessions so similar IP classes get consistent analysis, risk language, and mitigation guidance.
* Look for new and practical ways to detect, assess, and mitigate risk, including improved methods, automation, and lessons from prior findings.
* Use agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) to speed research and first drafts without handing off ownership of risk conclusions.
* Run the job in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track vulnerability and risk work, keep documentation current, and version work products through review.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Give product teams vulnerability analysis and risk determinations they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
* Reduce time-to-mitigation by explaining findings clearly and agreeing practical next steps with the teams that own the product.
* Leave mitigation and test guidance that design, verification, and firmware teams can execute.
* Keep residual risk visible and current so internal release and treatment decisions are based on evidence, not stale status.
* Improve consistency of vulnerability handling and risk language across similar IP classes.
* Raise the quality of risk reduction over time by bringing new methods, better mitigations, and fit-for-purpose tools into the workflow.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
* Typically 3 or more years in vulnerability management, product cybersecurity, embedded security, or a closely related engineering role. Stronger evidence on vulnerability analysis and risk determination can offset fewer years. Title (Analyst or Senior Analyst) will match demonstrated depth.
* Strong practical experience in vulnerability analysis on real products, not only scanning or training exercises.
* Ability to determine risk: severity, exploitability, affected assets, likelihood, impact, and residual risk after proposed mitigations.
* Ability to explain vulnerabilities and recommended mitigations to engineering teams so they can act in a timelyway.
* Working familiarity with semiconductor IP development and associated testing, including the tools used to design, verify, and test IP. Specific commercial tool names are not required.
* Ability to write and maintain your own tools, including in Python, for analysis, intake, scoring, and reporting when existing tools are not enough. This is not a software-engineering role. Tools should be readable and usable by other analysts.
* Experience working with incomplete information and stating assumptions when the end-system is not fully known.
Experience* ing a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, design, implementation, verification, and internal release, including tracking open risk to closure.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded systems enough to reason about hardware-rooted and firmware vulnerabilities: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, interfaces, registers, boot and debug, and interconnects.
* Experience delivering analysis inside product-team cadence, including re-prioritizing when new findings or design changes arrive.
* Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.

* Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions with geographically distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of common vulnerability scoring and handling practice (for example CVSS) is helpful, as is ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard, digital design or verification background (including RTL), semiconductor IP product experience, or applied embedded cryptography.

**Who You Are:**

* You build trust with design and product teams and keep working relationships strong when the discussion is about risk.
* You own the technical conclusion. You do not hand off judgment to a scanner, a score, a tool, or the loudest voice in the room.
* You write and speak clearly so engineers can understand a vulnerability and how to mitigate it without you in the room.
* You work well with incomplete information, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
* You drive timely action. You keep risk visible until it is treated or accepted with a clear rationale.
* You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend mitigations teams can actually adopt.
* You keep learning. You look for new and practical ways to assess and reduce risk, not only the methods you already know.
* You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as findings and designs change.

**The Team You’ll Be** **A** **Part Of:**

You will join the CySec Vulnerability Management Team that supports Synopsys semiconductor IP products. You work with IP product teams in their delivery cadence. You collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, firmware, and verification engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to analyze vulnerabilities, determine risk, and agree mitigations through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Your written work products are used by internal product and engineering teams.

**Rewards and Benefits:**

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: ServiceNow ITSM Techno-Functional Consultant
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**


To support the Service Automation team within Siemens Energy's Digital Core, this role is established to backfill capacity and address the increased workload from expanded responsibilities and upcoming strategic Energy Now initiatives. Operating at the Experienced Professional (P2\) level in India, the consultant will ensure operational stability, service excellence, and successful execution across key service areas. To address these business aims, the role focuses on ServiceNow ITSM solution design, platform configuration, and stakeholder collaboration. These core areas ensure alignment between business processes and technical implementations while driving out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) adoption and minimizing platform customizations.


**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **ServiceNow Solution Design \& Implementation**
* + Design and deliver scalable, upgrade\-safe solutions across ServiceNow ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management) leveraging out\-of\-the\-box (OOTB) capabilities.
	+ Configure core platform architecture, including Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, custom scripting, and third\-party tool integrations (e.g., Snowflake, Jira, Salesforce).
	+ Implement and manage technical integrations using REST, SOAP, MID Server, and Import Sets, ensuring alignment with platform security models and ACLs.
	+ Promote OOTB adoption, minimize unnecessary customizations, and leverage ServiceNow AI capabilities to deliver efficient solutions.
* **Functional Consulting \& Stakeholder Management**
* + Conduct discovery workshops and sessions with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate requirements into functional specifications.
	+ Prepare comprehensive design documents and define acceptance criteria to guide technical teams and review final solution designs.
	+ Provide strategic recommendations on ServiceNow best practices, process optimization, and alignment with CMDB, CSDM, and SPM modules.
* **Project Delivery \& Operational Support**
* + Collaborate within Agile/Scrum and SAFe delivery environments to support the execution of strategic EnergyNow projects and initiatives.
	+ Perform acceptance testing, validate solutions against requirements, and coordinate deployment activities with delivery partners to ensure operational stability.

**What You Bring**

* 6 to 8 years of professional experience in ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – IT Service Management (CIS\-ITSM).
* ServiceNow ITSM implementation and techno\-functional consulting experience.
* ServiceNow Core Architecture \& Administration.
* Flow Designer \& IntegrationHub Configuration.
* ServiceNow Scripting \& Customization Best Practices.
* Integration Technologies (REST, SOAP, MID Server, Import Sets).
* IT Service Management (ITSM) Process Design.
* Common Service Data Model (CSDM) \& CMDB.
* Requirement Gathering \& Business Systems Analysis.
* Solution Architecture \& Design Documentation.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication.
* Agile/Scrum \& SAFe Methodologies.
* Analytical Problem\-Solving.

**About the Team**


Our Corporate and Global Functions play a critical role in driving Siemens Energy’s strategic initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across departments, business areas, and regions. As part of this team, you will contribute to shaping the global energy transition, partner with internal and external stakeholders, and conduct business responsibly while adhering to legal and regulatory requirements.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**


At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.


Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.


Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**


Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

* Employees are eligible for remote working arrangements up to 2 days per week.
* Opportunities to work with a distributed, global team.
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects.
